author: Second Wind
description:
Scream 7 is the latest entry in a recent wave of IP work defined by franchise exhaustion: Joker: Folie à Deux, The Matrix Resurrections, Alien: Covenant, John Wick 4, and so on. These films are often openly contemptuous of their own existence, folding that self-awareness into the very text of their stories.
